datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mozambique. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases (IPC classifications) for February, June, and October 2017, spatially distributed across administrative units with scenario-based classifications.
